raw.query:
WITH cols AS (
  SELECT array_agg(column_name ORDER BY ordinal_position) AS names
  FROM information_schema.columns
  WHERE table_schema = 'provenance' AND table_name = 'collector_encoder_fn'
), base AS (
  SELECT * FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn
), summary AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_valid) AS valid_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_images BETWEEN 1 AND 64) AS n_1_64_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_valid AND n_images BETWEEN 1 AND 64) AS valid_n_1_64_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_valid AND n_images BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND attn IS NOT NULL) AS valid_attention_n_1_64_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_valid AND n_images BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND attn IS NULL) AS valid_attn_null_n_1_64_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT (image_px, n_images, patches, post_merge_tokens, attn)) FILTER (WHERE is_valid AND n_images BETWEEN 1 AND 64) AS distinct_valid_shape_attn_tuples,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source_path ILIKE '%infill%' OR COALESCE(note, '') ILIKE '%infill%' OR raw::text ILIKE '%infill%') AS rows_labeled_infill,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source_path ILIKE '%gemm%' OR COALESCE(note, '') ILIKE '%gemm%' OR raw::text ILIKE '%gemm%') AS rows_labeled_gemm
  FROM base
), breakdown AS (
  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'source_path', source_path,
    'is_valid', is_valid,
    'class', class,
    'rows_n_1_64', cases
  ) ORDER BY source_path, is_valid, class) AS by_source_validity_class
  FROM (
    SELECT source_path, is_valid,
           CASE WHEN attn IS NULL THEN 'attn_null' ELSE 'attention' END AS class,
           COUNT(*) AS cases
    FROM base
    WHERE n_images BETWEEN 1 AND 64
    GROUP BY source_path, is_valid, CASE WHEN attn IS NULL THEN 'attn_null' ELSE 'attention' END
  ) x
)
SELECT summary.*, cols.names AS owning_table_columns,
       NOT ('is_current' = ANY(cols.names)) AS is_current_absent,
       NOT ('is_superseded' = ANY(cols.names)) AS is_superseded_absent,
       NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(cols.names) c WHERE c ILIKE '%effective%') AS effective_columns_absent,
       NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(cols.names) c WHERE c ILIKE '%fold%' OR c ILIKE '%window%') AS fold_window_columns_absent,
       breakdown.by_source_validity_class
FROM summary CROSS JOIN cols CROSS JOIN breakdown
